name: cmux.sidebar/1
docs: A custom sidebar that replaces the workspace list (honored from the user's own local/customize app only; plans/cmux-next/custom-sidebar-DESIGN.md). The render export returns a view; the titlebar row, sections and footer stay native. Classic `sidebar(fn)` scripts set this export through the compat layer. Data comes from live catalog reads (`data.workspaces()` and friends); scene ops leave only when a prop's value changed.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
